decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a first floor side extension to the dwelling house at 68 Harewood Road would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding area, and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003), and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 68 Harewood Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The existing garage (for the avoidance of doubt, that shown on Drawing No. 2206/PA/2A) shall be retained and thereafter it shall not be used for any other purpose other than the parking of private vehicles.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension to the existing house
